questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

A. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London last year.
B. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London in 2010.
C. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London for ten years.
D. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London yesterday.
options: A. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London last year.
B. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London in 2010.
C. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London for ten years.
D. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London yesterday.
questions.answer: A. I have lived here since 2010, but I moved to London last year.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?

A. She has finished her homework already.
B. She finished her homework yesterday.
C. She is finishing her homework now.
D. She will finish her homework tomorrow.
options: A. She has finished her homework already.
B. She finished her homework yesterday.
C. She is finishing her homework now.
D. She will finish her homework tomorrow.
questions.answer: A. She has finished her homework already.

questions.question:
Select the correct option to complete the sentence:

If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

A. rains
B. will rain
C. rained
D. is raining

Choose the best answer:

I have ______ to Paris three times before.

A. been
B. been not
C. not been
D. never been

Which sentence is grammatically correct?

A. Having been to the cinema, the film was interesting.
B. Having been to the cinema, I found the film interesting.
C. Having been to the cinema, I have found the film interesting.
D. Having been to the cinema, I find the film interesting.
options: A. Having been to the cinema, the film was interesting.
B. Having been to the cinema, I found the film interesting.
C. Having been to the cinema, I have found the film interesting.
D. Having been to the cinema, I find the film interesting.
questions.answer: B. Having been to the cinema, I found the film interesting.

questions.question:
Select the correct conditional sentence:

If I ______ more time, I ______ learn Spanish.

A. had, would
B. had, would have
C. have, will
D. had, will

Choose the correct modal verb for the sentence:

You ______ be careful when driving in the city.

A. can
B. must
C. should
D. could

Which sentence correctly uses the gerund or infinitive?

A. I prefer swimming rather than to row.
B. I prefer to swim rather than rowing.
C. I prefer swimming rather than rowing.
D. I prefer to swim rather than to row.
options: A. I prefer swimming rather than to row.
B. I prefer to swim rather than rowing.
C. I prefer swimming rather than rowing.
D. I prefer to swim rather than to row.
questions.answer: C. I prefer swimming rather than rowing.

questions.question:
Select the correct comparative form:

This book is ______ interesting than the one I read last week.

A. more
B. much
C. a lot
D. very

Which word best completes the sentence?

The weather in summer is ______ hot here.

A. very
B. quite
C. extremely
D. too
